name: The Spirit of Outa
source:
After a near burn-out project at work, you go camping in a forest to sleep better, but you find yourself in a magic forest instead...

[From [url=https://ebbasuke.itch.io/the-spirit-of-outa]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在经历了一次几乎精疲力尽的工作后，你去森林里露营以睡得更好，但你却发现自己身处一片魔法森林中……

[来自[url=https://ebbasuke.itch.io/the-spirit-of-outa]Itch.io[/url]]
